mapper.sql: p.perm_seq, p.perm_id, p.perm_name, p.module_code, p.menu_path, p.sort_order, p.use_yn, p.created_by, p.created_at, p.updated_by, p.updated_at, (SELECT string_agg(a.action_code, ',' ORDER BY a.action_code) FROM tb_permission_action a WHERE a.perm_seq = p.perm_seq) AS actions, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rp.role_seq) FROM tb_role_permission rp WHERE rp.perm_seq = p.perm_seq) AS role_count, (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT r.role_name, ',') FROM tb_role_permission rp JOIN tb_role r ON r.role_seq = rp.role_seq WHERE rp.perm_seq = p.perm_seq) AS role_names

where.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_role_permission rp WHERE rp.perm_seq = p.perm_seq)

AND ( LOWER(p.perm_id) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(p.perm_name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.menu_path, '')) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_permission WHERE perm_id = #{permId}

mapper.insert:
